skill.name: setup-pre-commit
skill.description: Set up Husky pre-commit hooks with lint-staged, Prettier, optional type checking, and tests in JavaScript or TypeScript repositories.
skill.summary: Set up Husky, lint-staged, Prettier, and optional checks before commits.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection or hidden malicious intent was found in SKILL.md. The static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks and standard command examples, while one semantic risk remains for staging all changed files before commit.

remediation.suggestion: Stage only files created or modified by the setup, then ask the user before creating a commit.
Show the package manager command before installing dependencies or running npx commands, and wait for user approval when appropriate.
Prefer project-approved versions, or explain that installation may fetch current package releases.

semantic_findings.title: Overbroad Git Staging Instruction
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md line 83 instructs the agent to stage all changed or created files and commit them. This can include unrelated user changes or sensitive files created outside the setup task.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction is explicit in the commit step. The impact depends on repository state, so confidence is high but not absolute for every use.

content.value_statement: Manual hook setup is easy to misconfigure across package managers. This skill guides Husky, lint-staged, Prettier, type checking, and tests.
actual_capabilities: Detects npm, pnpm, yarn, or bun from lockfiles.
Installs Husky, lint-staged, and Prettier as development dependencies.
Initializes Husky and creates a pre-commit hook.
Adds lint-staged formatting for staged files.
Creates a default Prettier config when none exists.
limitations: It is designed for repositories with package.json workflows.
It does not choose project-specific Prettier style rules.
It cannot guarantee tests are fast enough for every commit.
It should not stage unrelated user changes without review.

use_cases.title: New JavaScript Project
use_cases.description: Add a consistent pre-commit workflow before teammates start committing code.

use_cases.title: Team Formatting Cleanup
use_cases.description: Standardize staged-file formatting and reduce style-only review comments.

use_cases.title: Existing TypeScript App
use_cases.description: Add typecheck and test commands to pre-commit when those scripts already exist.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup in a package.json repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up Husky, lint-staged, and Prettier pre-commit hooks in this repository. Detect the package manager first.

prompt_templates.title: Use Existing Scripts
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure pre-commit hooks with lint-staged formatting. Include typecheck and test only if package.json already defines those scripts.

prompt_templates.title: Respect Existing Config
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced setup in a repository with existing formatting rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Husky pre-commit hooks without replacing existing Prettier or lint-staged settings. Show the files you changed and why.

prompt_templates.title: Audit And Harden
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing hook workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current hook setup, identify missing safeguards, then update Husky and lint-staged while avoiding unrelated staged changes.

output_examples.input: Set up pre-commit hooks for a pnpm TypeScript project.
output: Installed Husky, lint-staged, and Prettier as development dependencies.
Created a pre-commit hook that formats staged files and runs existing checks.

output_examples.input: Add Prettier to pre-commit without changing our existing config.
output_examples.output: Keeps the existing formatting configuration, adds lint-staged to the hook, and reports each file changed.

output_examples.input: Our repo has no test script.
output_examples.output: Omits the test command from the hook and explains that no package script was available.

best_practices: Review package manager detection before installing dependencies.
Keep pre-commit checks fast enough for frequent commits.
Stage only setup files and intentionally reviewed project changes.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite an existing Prettier config without approval.
Do not add test or typecheck commands that package.json does not define.
Do not stage every changed file without checking ownership.

faq.question: What package managers does this skill support?
faq.answer: It detects npm, pnpm, yarn, and bun from common lockfiles.

faq.question: Will it replace my existing Prettier config?
faq.answer: No. It should create a default Prettier config only when no config exists.

faq.question: Does it always add tests to the hook?
faq.answer: No. It should add test commands only when package.json already defines them.

faq.question: Can it work without Husky?
faq.answer: No. The workflow is built around Husky pre-commit hooks.

faq.question: Will it format all files in the repository?
faq.answer: No. lint-staged is configured to format staged files.

faq.question: Is it safe to commit automatically?
faq.answer: Review changed files first. The audit recommends staging only setup-related files before committing.
